messages:
maya: Quick async standup for embed-cache launch
maya: What I did — sketched rollout plan, updated spec doc (links below), opened PR #842 for cache invalidation logic
maya: Blockers — TTL behavior ambiguous for deduped requests; need product decision on default 1h vs 24h
maya: Today — pair with Leo on PR, get QA smoke tests, finalize console metrics names

leo: saw the PR, left inline comments re: race on cache warm path. can fix in next commit.
leo: question: do we want per-customer TTL overrides? that changes schema a bit.

priya: prefer keeping default conservative (24h) and expose override in dedicated capacity only.
priya: if we expose per-customer TTL, we should add an admin-only API not in public API.

sam: I can own QA smoke. Will run a quick matrix today: cold cache, warm cache, invalidation.
sam: ping @maya for the exact scenarios. I have a small script — will post results here.

elliot: note from PM: launch priority is still "canary -> staggered rollout"; don't do global defaults until metrics look good.
elliot: also update the release notes with the deprecation warning for previous header `x-embed-ttl`.

maya: @priya agreed on 24h default and admin-only override. @leo please adjust PR to remove public param.
maya: linking spec: https://redwood-internal/specs/embed-cache-launch (draft)

leo: updated PR to reflect admin-only override, pushed commit 7b3f8. removed public header.
leo: left a todo to add telemetry for hit/miss ratio per-request.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: embed-cache v1.0 -> canary group at 2026-03-18T14:00Z. monitor: latency, error-rate, cache-hit

qa-bot: smoke run failed for scenario "invalidation-after-update" — stack trace snippet:
```
ERROR: cache_invalidate() -> KeyError on missing shard
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/smoke/invalidation.py", line 42, in run
    router.invalidate(key)
KeyError: 'shard-7'
```
qa-bot: tagging @leo and @sam

sam: on it — reproducing locally now. likely a race when we write+invalidate during concurrent writes.
sam: will post a minimal repro and PR for fix.

maya: thanks all. next steps: Leo + Sam fix and get green smoke, Elliot update release notes, Priya signoff on admin API docs. I'll unblock canary once smoke is green. :thumbsup:
